text.body: ॥ śivaśaṅkarāṣṭakam ॥ atirbhāṣaṇa kaṭubhāṣaṇa yamakiṅkarapaṭalīkṛtatāḍanaparipīḍanamaraṇāgamasamaye। umayā saha mama cetasi yamaśāsananivasaṃ śivaśaṅkara śiva śaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 1 asadindriyaviṣayodayasukhasāskṛtasukṛteḥ para dūṣaṇa paritoṣaṇa kṛtapātakavikṛteḥ । paramālaya paripālaya paritāpana miti māṃ śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 2 viṣayābhidha baḍiśāyudha piśitāyutasubhagaṃ masikāyutamatisantatimarubhūmiṣu niratam । mṛḍa māmava sugaterava śivayā saha kṛpayā śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 3 dayitāmava duhitāmava jananīmava janakaṃ mama kalpitamatisantati marubhūmiṣu niratam । janitāsukhavanitāsakha vasatiṃ kuru sumatiṃ śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 4 jananāśana mṛtimocana śivapūjana niraterabhitokṛśamitayedṛśamahamāharamivaham । gajakacchapajanitaśramamuralīkurasumatiṃ śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara mehara duritam ॥ 5 tvayi tiṣṭhati sakalasthitiparamātmani hṛdaye vasumārgaṇakṛpaṇekṣaṇa manasā śiva vimukham । akṛtāhnikamanupoṣaka bhavatādgirisutayā śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 6 pitarāviti nu kadāviti yutayokṛta hṛdaye śivayoḥ padamabhiyāhyuru paṇasattava sukṛteḥ । iti me śiva hṛdayaṃ bhavadāttatarayayā śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 7 śaraṇāgata bharaṇādṛta karuṇāmṛtajaladhe śaraṇaṃ tava caraṇaṃ śivabhava saṃsṛtivasate । vara cinmaya jagadāmayabhiṣagānatamavatāt śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 8 tripurāntaka tridaśeśvaragaṇanāyaka śiva te śaraṇaṃ bhava kṛtasāgaraphaṇikaṅkaṇacaraṇam । vṛṣavāhana viṣadūṣaṇa patitoddhara śaraṇaṃ śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 9 śaśiśekhara śivadāyaka hariśāyaka girijāpriyanāyaka gajakandhara gajadānavaharaṇa । kanakāsanakanakāmbaravināśana śaraṇaṃ śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkara hara me hara duritam ॥ 10 vijitendriya vibudhārcita vimalāmbujacaraṇa bhavanāśana bhayanāśana bhajitāṅkitahṛdaya । phaṇibhūṣaṇamunipoṣaṇa madanāntaka śaraṇaṃ śivaśaṅkara śivaśaṅkarahara me hara duritam ॥ 11 ॥ iti śrī śivaśaṅkarāṣṭakam ॥
